overhang.max_angle.measured_on: decided: the usual limit of a face printed without support, measured from vertical
overhang.max_angle.description: flattest down-facing face, as an angle from vertical

overhang.max_bridge.measured_on: decided; spans of 3 to 4.5 printed clean on one printer (0.6 nozzle)

overhang.bridge_step.description: height of a bridge step under a counterbore that faces the bed

overhang.support_growth_share.description: growth of the support line of a part against its baseline that fails

overhang.support_growth_abs.measured_on: written by an agent, never confirmed by an owner
overhang.support_growth_abs.description: growth of the support line of a part, in mm of line, that fails
